task.title: P6-019: Vendor a real icon set to replace colliding emoji stand-ins
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-019. Size: M. Specs: specs/ui-components.md, specs/ui-design.md.

**No icon set is vendored, so the app uses emoji stand-ins for lucide glyphs — and two of them collide.** 🗂 (All cards) and 📁 (a collection) render near-identically at 15 px on most platforms (`root.rs:50`, `:52`), so on the mobile `/my` root the aggregate-vs-collection distinction rests entirely on `font-semibold` plus one divider (`root.rs:130-149`, `:178`, `:290`). The wireframes specify distinct lucide glyphs (`layers` vs `folder`) throughout, and no icon crate appears in `Cargo.toml`. Vendoring a real set is the durable fix and pays off across every screen.
